title: OpenClaw for Small Business: 7 Workflows That Save Your Team 15 Hours a Week
summary: OpenClaw automations for 2-20 person businesses — customer follow-ups, invoice chasing, meeting prep, weekly reporting, and 3 more workflows that run 24/7.
body_markdown: Solopreneurs use OpenClaw to replace the work of multiple employees — one person, AI-multiplied. Small businesses use it differently: the agent becomes the coordination layer that keeps the team in sync, routes information to the right person, and handles admin tasks that currently fall between teammates. The automation is similar; the goal is eliminating coordination overhead, not just personal admin.
